resources.string: No bytes are sent to the hardware. The app only logs which packets it would send.

How to start:
1. Close the DJI Fly app (swipe it from recents).
2. Power on the controller.
3. Plug the USB‑OTG cable into the LOWER USB‑C port of the controller, the other end into your phone.
4. If Android asks: pick »FCC Switch«.
5. Tap »Search controller«.
Allow USB access in the system dialog (tick »Always use« so the dialog will not appear again).\nNo dialog? Tap »Connect« again.
Connection established. Tap »Continue« to prepare the FCC patch.

What happens when you enable FCC:
• 2 packets (37 bytes) are sent to the controller → radio chip switches to FCC.
• More transmit power, more range, 2.4 + 5.8 GHz.
• The drone itself stays untouched.

IMPORTANT: Right after the patch you MUST power the controller off and on again, otherwise FCC will not become active.
2 packets (37 bytes) are sent to the controller and switch the radio mode to FCC.
• Only the controller is changed, not the drone.
• Afterwards the controller MUST be powered off and on again — required.
• Outside FCC regions this can be legally problematic.
✅ FCC patch sent — now restart the controller!
Do this exactly in this order:
Unplug the USB cable from the controller.

Power the controller OFF and back ON (long‑press power until all LEDs go dark, then long‑press again to turn it on).\n⚠ Mandatory: without this restart FCC will not become active.\n⚠ Do NOT power off the drone — otherwise the patch must be repeated.
Wait until the controller has fully booted (status LEDs glow steadily).
Power on the drone and wait for the link (beep / steady LED).
Now plug the USB‑OTG cable into the UPPER USB‑C port of the controller.
Open DJI Fly — it will reconnect automatically.
Is FCC active? How to verify:
// HOW TO RECOGNIZE FCC IN DJI FLY
DJI Fly → ⚙ Settings → Control → Frequency band
DJI Fly → Settings → Transmission: »Frequency band« shows 2.4 + 5.8 GHz (CE = 2.4 only).
Range display in the camera view: FCC ≈ 10–15 km theory, CE ≈ 6 km.
Field test: stable link beyond ≈ 1.5 km outdoors = FCC is running.
Power off the controller → back to CE → re‑apply the patch.
A controller firmware update may remove the patch.
Powering off the drone alone does NOT break it — as long as the controller stays on.
Enabling FCC outside FCC regions (e.g. EU) can be legally problematic. Only use this app where it is allowed. No warranty, no liability.
This app is free and funded by ads (Google AdMob).\n\nPlease choose how we may show ads:

• Personalized: ads matching your interests (cookies / IDs).
• Non‑personalized: generic ads, no profiling.
• Reject: no ads, the app keeps working.

You can change this any time via »Privacy settings«.
